","down_step2":"data:image/png;base64,","box0":"data:image/png;base64,","box1":"data:image/png;base64,","box2":"data:image/png;base64,","box3":"data:image/png;base64,"};
const heroSpriteImages={};
let heroSpritesReady=false;
(function loadHeroSprites(){
let remaining=Object.keys(HERO_SPRITE_DATA).length;
for(const [name,uri] of Object.entries(HERO_SPRITE_DATA)){
const image=new Image();
image.onload=image.onerror=()=>{remaining--;if(remaining===0)heroSpritesReady=true};
heroSpriteImages[name]=image;
image.src=uri;
}
})();
const HERO_WALK_FRAMES={
right:['right_step1','right_idle','right_step2','right_idle'],
left:['left_step1','left_idle','left_step2','left_idle'],
up:['up_step1','up_idle','up_step2','up_idle'],
down:['down_step1','down_idle','down_step2','down_idle']
};
// Do not rotate an image as the character moves diagonally: choose its nearest
// cardinal facing, and preserve a compatible previous facing near the 45-degree line.
function setHeroFacing(dx,dy){
if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<.00001)return;
const adx=Math.abs(dx),ady=Math.abs(dy);
const horiz=dx>=0?'right':'left',vert=dy>=0?'down':'up';
if(adx>ady*1.14)player.dir=horiz;
else if(ady>adx*1.14)player.dir=vert;
else if(player.dir!==horiz&&player.dir!==vert)player.dir=vert;
}
function drawHero(p){
const x=p.x*TILE,y=p.y*TILE;
const action=building?'box':p.anim==='walk'?'walk':'idle';
let key;
if(action==='box'){
const sequence=['box0','box1','box2','box3'];
const fraction=building?Math.max(0,Math.min(1,building.elapsed/building.duration)):0;
key=sequence[Math.min(sequence.length-1,Math.floor(fraction*sequence.length))];
}else if(action==='walk'){
const sequence=HERO_WALK_FRAMES[p.dir||'down'];
key=sequence[Math.floor((p.animClock||0)*8)%sequence.length];
}else key=(p.dir||'down')+'_idle';
const img=heroSpriteImages[key];
if(!heroSpritesReady||!img||!img.complete||!img.naturalWidth){drawFigure(p,'#417ecc','★',true);return;}
// Keep the same character height while standing and walking; crouch during unpacking.
const targetH=action==='box'?52:58;
const scale=targetH/img.naturalHeight;
const w=img.naturalWidth*scale,h=img.naturalHeight*scale;
ctx.save();ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
ctx.fillStyle='#0008';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y+10,11,4.5,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.drawImage(img,x-w/2,y-h+15,w,h);
ctx.restore();
}
